function.name: aura_search
function.description: Retrieve citable passages from registered official sources for one technical or factual question. Prefer over a generic web search for API docs, pricing, config, lifecycle, and error-code questions. Returns evidence passages with source URLs; mode=none means the question is outside the registry.

function.name: aura_search_batch
function.description: Run multiple independent questions in one call. Keeps per-question results, bounded concurrency, and a shared page cache; at most 20 questions.

function.name: aura_fetch
function.description: Fetch one public HTTP(S) URL and return clean Markdown with title, length, and truncation flag. Private/loopback targets are blocked by default.

function.name: aura_sources
function.description: List registered entities and their official sources, so the caller knows whether search has authoritative coverage.
